architecture: Hammerhead: one continuous transverse armored bar and a short central prow; straight broad span, flat stern
weapons: twin heavy barrels at both far tips, central gun

architecture: Catamaran: two separate broad parallel hulls divided by a long open slot, connected by a short transverse bridge
weapons: one heavy turret on each outer hull and paired guns at the bridge

architecture: Crescent: one thick curved sickle hull, concave open gap facing the bow; blunt center cockpit protrudes below arc
weapons: large cannon in each crescent horn, central energy gun

architecture: Octagonal fortress: broad low eight-sided armored deck with cropped corners and a short polygonal nose
weapons: corner bastion turrets and recessed central batteries

architecture: Crab chassis: compact central carapace with four thick jointed lateral claws making a wide jagged outline
weapons: claw-tip cannons and armored central mortar

architecture: Trimaran: three separated short longitudinal hulls, one middle prow and two broad outer hulls joined aft
weapons: three forward batteries and outer missile pods

architecture: H-platform: two broad vertical side pylons bridged at their middle, with exposed open bays in front and rear
weapons: endcap gun clusters on all four side pylon ends

architecture: Chevron pair: two disconnected broad swept forward plates linked only by a small central armored hinge, deep V voids
weapons: outer-end cannons and hinge-mounted twin cannon

architecture: Halo: broad flattened elliptical armor ring with a real central hole and a small suspended central gun module
weapons: ring-edge turrets at far ends and central axial cannon

architecture: X-cross: four stout diagonal armor arms radiating from a compact square reactor, with open quadrants
weapons: large guns at left and right arm tips

architecture: Manta: smooth broad curved organic-metal wings with scalloped rear edge and a short bulbous blunt prow
weapons: embedded wing-tip energy cannons and ventral central gun

architecture: Carrier: extremely wide rectangular flight deck with inset hangar slots, squared stern and shallow command island
weapons: side elevator gun pods and far corner turrets

architecture: Split boomerang: two sharply angled boomerang half-wings separated by a narrow central void, lower bow bridge
weapons: broad endcap guns and bridge-mounted batteries

architecture: Twin rings: two independent oval armored loops side by side, connected by narrow central reinforced crossbar
weapons: outer rim artillery and crossbar center gun

architecture: Dumbbell bastion: two equally massive outboard octagonal gun citadels joined by a pinched narrow central waist and short centered prow; bilateral mirror symmetry
weapons: matching heavy guns on both outer citadels and central axial cannon

architecture: Opposed brackets: two mirrored squared inward-curving armored brackets facing a suspended centered diamond reactor across two large open side channels; bilateral mirror symmetry
weapons: matching bracket-tip cannons and central reactor battery

architecture: Lattice frame: wide triangular truss cells with several large negative-space windows between reinforced beams
weapons: heavy guns at outer beam vertices

architecture: Stepped wing: single broad horizontal deck with three successive staggered rectangular wing terraces per side
weapons: terrace-end guns and forward deck battery

architecture: Floating core: central hexagonal reactor pod and four separate massive side wing blocks connected by exposed struts
weapons: guns on each separated wing block

architecture: Five-prong siege rake: broad straight rear crossbar with five evenly spaced short armored gun tines reaching forward, a central tine and two mirrored pairs; bilateral mirror symmetry
weapons: five massive forward-facing tine cannons with outer tips prominent

architecture: Spider siege machine: wide central armored body and six thick segmented mechanical legs, three each side
weapons: artillery at outer leg joints and prow gun

architecture: Triple W: shallow serrated front with three V-shaped deep notches and four projecting armored forward points
weapons: paired guns on outer and inner points

architecture: Shield disc: broad flattened oval shield slab, continuous armored perimeter, twin side gun gondolas and tiny prow
weapons: two exposed giant rim-mounted cannons

architecture: U-horseshoe: squared hollow U-frame with open bow-facing center bay, thick two side rails and rear crossmember
weapons: forward rail-tip guns and aft crossmember missile arrays

architecture: Wide wedge: extremely shallow thick trapezoidal delta slab with broad straight rear edge and one short central tooth
weapons: long cannons built into far side corners

architecture: Ziggurat: three stacked wide terraced decks stepping inward vertically toward raised center citadel
weapons: tier-edge heavy gun towers and citadel cannon

architecture: Forked wing: left and right wing each split into two large separate tapered tines with deep open slots
weapons: guns on all four tine tips

architecture: Pancake gunship: low circular central saucer attached to two straight transverse cannon rails
weapons: rail-end siege guns, radial deck turrets

architecture: Crenellated siege wall: wide shallow rectangular fortification with alternating projecting box bastions along the bow
weapons: bastion gun chambers and far-end double batteries

architecture: Corner-halo citadel: hollow rhombus perimeter with four massive separated square corner pylons and short inner bridge
weapons: large guns on corner pylons

architecture: Seven-ray star: wide, flattened radial star with one central ray and three mirrored pairs of angular armor rays around a centered reactor; bilateral mirror symmetry
weapons: outer ray batteries, protected core gun

architecture: Twin-boom carrier: broad forward transverse armor deck, two separated heavy rear booms and a large open stern void
weapons: outboard forward gun pods and central deck cannon

architecture: Bridge arch: broad trapezoid whose front is hollowed into a giant full-width arch aperture, twin load-bearing piers
weapons: pier-end artillery and top deck guns

architecture: Mirrored gullwing cruiser: centered armored command pod and two identical sharply kinked wings rising at the inner joints then spreading as horizontal outboard platforms; bilateral mirror symmetry
weapons: one matching siege cannon on each far wing and center battery

architecture: Modular chain: five distinct heavy hexagonal armor cells linked horizontally by narrow visible trusses
weapons: heavy guns at two outer cells, turrets on three inner cells

architecture: Artillery rail: ultra-wide shallow straight weapons deck carrying three monumental parallel axial rail cannons
weapons: three huge open barrel mouths and flanking gun towers

architecture: Butterfly: four independent angular armor panels in opposing pairs, separated by an X-shaped central void
weapons: large paired guns at far panel ends

architecture: Trident: three thick forward prongs across the entire width, tied by a narrow straight stern beam
weapons: huge cannons on all three prong tips

architecture: Comb-back: straight broad forward shield plate with six parallel short rear-facing mechanical fins and open slots
weapons: two huge outer prow guns and four distributed turrets

architecture: Double-beak crab: two separate broad angular forward armored beaks, central recessed reactor and rear straight crossbar
weapons: beak tip guns and far outer flanking cannon pods

architecture: Castellated shield wall: a horizontal chain of tall alternating square bastions rising from a shallow armored spine
weapons: fort turret on each bastion and heavy side guns

architecture: Accordion: four wide interlocking zigzag armor bands joined by exposed mechanical hinges, extremely shallow outline
weapons: end hinge batteries and two central siege guns

architecture: Six-cell honeycomb fortress: six huge polygonal armored modules in two shallow mirrored rows of three, with visible open seams and a central reactor between the inner cells; bilateral mirror symmetry
weapons: identical giant far-left and far-right cell guns plus interior turret batteries

architecture: Parallel twin spine: two very long horizontal heavy beams one behind the other, separated by a wide open slot, four stout vertical links
weapons: large end guns on both beams and link-mounted turrets

architecture: Fractured diamond: central diamond command fortress surrounded by four distinct disconnected massive armor tiles on heavy bridges
weapons: guns at outer tile corners and central gun

architecture: Reactor dish: giant flattened circular reactor housing with two thick asymmetric rectangular wing batteries attached laterally
weapons: four side battery cannons and axial dish gun

architecture: Four-link loop: four small hollow polygonal fortress rings arranged horizontally and joined by massive external crossbars
weapons: outer loop cannon towers and middle beam siege guns

architecture: Double V barrier: two nested broad parallel shallow V-shaped armored shield walls separated by one continuous open V channel and joined by six short pillars, bilaterally mirror symmetric
weapons: matching colossal outboard cannons and central layered batteries

architecture: Archipelago: three large non-touching armored islands arranged across a wide front, suspended from two rear transverse girders
weapons: heavy artillery on each island and outermost pods

architecture: Unique endgame citadel: immense wide double-tier fortress with a hollow central quadrilateral reactor court, two giant stepped outboard bastions, a shallow armored prow wall and six separate rear engine towers; unmistakable monumental architectural silhouette
weapons: two colossal central main cannons, heavy multi-barrel outer bastion batteries and tiered defense turrets
